column1: # SQL fact counters: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). srcmorph counts the pattern's
# matches over the whole source file and writes them as exact facts before the AI summary.
# The [ignore] line runs first: it blanks /* ... */ block comments (keeping the line breaks), but not
# MySQL's /*! ... */ version comments or Oracle's /*+ ... */ hints, which hold real SQL; a statement
# after an inline comment then starts its line. Statements are counted where they start a line,
# case-insensitive, for PostgreSQL, MySQL, T-SQL and Oracle. "VALUES rows (approx)" counts the row
# tuples of VALUES lists (a tuple after VALUES or after "),"), so a multi-row INSERT counts every row;
# rows an INSERT ... SELECT reads from a table are not seen, and a tuple nested inside a row counts
# once more. SqlFactPatternsTest pins every case.
